about: Official India IT-services fresher / graduate-trainee / campus portals. These firms rarely expose Greenhouse/Lever/Workday boards for India GET roles, so we scrape their public hiring pages and emit apply-ready openings.

portals.title: TCS All India NQT Hiring — Prime / Digital / Ninja (Freshers & 0–2 yrs)
portals.loc: Hyderabad · Bengaluru · Chennai · Pune · Mumbai · Delhi NCR · India
portals.desc: TCS All India National Qualifier Test (NQT) for batch 2024/2025/2026. Apply via TCS NextStep (IT category), click Apply For Drive, then sit the in-centre NQT for Prime / Digital / Ninja offers. Eligibility typically B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc, 60% aggregate, no pending backlogs. Helpdesk: ilp.support@tcs.com. Watch the NQT page and NextStep for the next registration window when the current drive is closed.

portals.title: Infosys Graduate / Specialist Programmer hiring (Freshers)
portals.loc: Hyderabad · Bengaluru · Chennai · Pune · Mysuru · India
portals.desc: Infosys graduate hiring and exclusive Power Programmer / Specialist Programmer tracks. Freshers and final-year students apply through Infosys Careers; campus and off-campus drives (including HackWithInfy pathways) feed into Systems Engineer and related entry roles.

portals.title: Wipro Graduate Engineer Trainee / Early Careers (Freshers)
portals.loc: Bengaluru · Hyderabad · Chennai · Pune · Gurugram · India
portals.desc: Wipro Early Careers / fresher hiring for Graduate Engineer Trainee and Associate Developer roles. Search Graduate Engineer Trainee on the Wipro careers portal and apply online. Typically open to recent engineering / MCA graduates (check each posting for batch and location).

portals.title: Cognizant GenC — Analyst Trainee / Graduate hiring (Freshers)
portals.loc: Hyderabad · Bengaluru · Chennai · Pune · Coimbatore · India
portals.desc: Generation Cognizant (GenC) is Cognizant's India fresher hiring and development program. Off-campus and campus drives open for specific streams and batches (e.g. Analyst Trainee for 3-year degrees; engineering GenC drives when listed). Apply only from the official GenC page / linked Superset form.

portals.title: HCLTech Graduate / Early Careers hiring (Freshers)
portals.desc: HCLTech graduate and early-career hiring across technology roles. Watch careers.hcltech.com for Graduate Engineer Trainee / fresher openings and off-campus drives.

portals.title: Capgemini Students & Graduates — India fresher hiring
portals.loc: Hyderabad · Bengaluru · Chennai · Mumbai · Pune · India
portals.desc: Capgemini India students and graduates pathway. Search fresher / graduate / trainee roles on Capgemini careers and apply to open campus or off-campus drives.

portals.title: Tech Mahindra Graduate / Fresher hiring
portals.desc: Tech Mahindra campus and off-campus fresher hiring for graduate engineer / associate roles. Apply via the official Tech Mahindra careers site.

portals.desc: LTIMindtree campus hiring and Graduate Engineer Trainee programs for freshers. Check the careers site for open GET / fresher postings and apply online.

portals.desc: Accenture India students and graduates hiring for Associate / Analyst / fresher technology roles. Search entry-level openings on Accenture careers and apply.
